facts.fact: On 18 December 2025 the Minister of Health, Jorge Figueiredo, announced that each citizen will get a unique patient code giving access to a digital clinical history (laboratory analyses, imaging, treatments) that health professionals can consult whichever hospital or health centre the patient attends, with electronic prescription alongside; stated as coming, with no count of facilities.
